main_subject.description: An adult woman with short blonde hair, soft freckles, minimal makeup, and a thoughtful sideward gaze.
main_subject.wardrobe: A simple gray knitted sweater, straight blue jeans, and a plain brown shoulder bag.
main_subject.pose_and_expression: Standing naturally in a pedestrian zone, looking slightly to the side rather than into camera.

composition_elements.setting: Busy generic city pedestrian street with anonymous background walkers rendered as non-identifiable soft motion and bokeh.
composition_elements.framing: Eye-level candid medium portrait; subject sharply focused against softly blurred crowd depth.
composition_elements.text_and_brand_control: No readable store signs, logos, text, personal data, or identifiable background faces.

lighting_and_atmosphere.lighting: Soft natural daylight with warm film-inspired tone and even shadow.
lighting_and_atmosphere.mood: Stillness within city movement, reflective and authentic.

technical_specs.rendering: Natural skin and knit texture, subtle grain, gentle background motion blur, realistic proportions.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a 4:5 vertical professional documentary street portrait of an adult woman with short blonde hair, soft freckles, minimal makeup, and a thoughtful sideward gaze. She wears a simple gray knitted sweater, straight blue jeans, and a plain brown shoulder bag, standing naturally in a generic city pedestrian zone. Surround her with a dense anonymous crowd rendered as soft non-identifiable motion and bokeh. Use eye-level candid medium framing, sharp focus on subject, soft daylight, warm film-inspired tone, natural skin and knit texture, subtle grain, gentle background motion blur, and realistic proportions. No readable signs, logos, text, personal data, identifiable background faces, or watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: minor, celebrity likeness, explicit, nsfw, overly revealing clothing, logo, readable text, identifiable bystander, watermark, plastic skin, distorted hands, AI artifacts

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Optional identity reference must depict a consenting adult. Wardrobe and crowd-street references guide general styling only; all copy and bystander identities must be removed.
